page: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-1xL40S is a KVM-based virtual server configured with an AMD EPYC 9575F processor. This x86_64 architecture CPU provides 16 vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system features 192 GB of system memory, yielding a high resource density of 12 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is driven by a single NVIDIA L40S GPU based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, equipped with 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not bundled with this instance type, and it includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Performance benchmarks indicate top-tier capabilities, particularly in single-core and multi-core processing. The server achieves top-tier status in Geekbench single-core and multi-core evaluations, alongside top-tier stress-ng single-core performance. Cryptographic and compression workloads perform strongly, with bzip3 single-threaded decompression reaching top-tier levels and multi-threaded decompression scoring in the top 25%. Large-block memory bandwidth reads and writes also rank in the top 25%, supporting high-throughput data transfers. For machine learning, LLM inference speeds for small models are top-tier, while medium model text generation ranks in the top 25%.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a balanced profile for GPU-accelerated workloads by pairing a high-capacity 48 GB VRAM GPU with a substantial 192 GB system memory array, avoiding the need for more expensive multi-GPU nodes. However, the shared CPU allocation and lack of local storage are notable tradeoffs that require external storage solutions. This configuration is highly suited for medium-scale LLM inference, image processing, data science pipelines, and parallelized mathematical simulations.
description: UpCloud GPU-16xCPU-192GB-1xL40S is a KVM-based virtual server designed for GPU-accelerated workloads. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9575F processor with 16 vCPUs, 192 GB of RAM, and a single NVIDIA L40S GPU with 48 GB of VRAM. The system does not include local storage. Performance benchmarks show top-tier single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities, alongside strong large-block memory bandwidth. LLM inference benchmarks demonstrate top-tier performance on small models and strong text generation on medium models. With a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 12 GB per core, this server provides a cost-effective platform for memory-intensive and GPU-accelerated tasks without the overhead of multi-GPU configurations. It is well-suited for machine learning inference, image processing, and data-intensive computations.
